interpretation_boundaries: Reported umbrella-project completion is retained as positive evidence but does not establish every asset's physical operation
Unknown physical status is not evidence that the assets are unenergized or late
Exact project completion, report upper bounds and physical commissioning remain different event types
Calendar subtraction is not a comparable delivery-performance measure without milestone/scope linkage
Without-program baseline attribution and source-supported declared financial facts remain separate from physical status
Source-native aggregate integration capability is not household-consumption headroom or programme-caused capacity
No timing probability, national weighting, actual cashflow or readiness promotion follows
review_method: Exact current HTML hashes verified; source fields/wording read manually. Absence of an explicit event date is an interpretive source review, not an automated proof of non-completion.
